Self-hosted fonts (Latin subset, WOFF2, variable weight), from Google Fonts:
- Inter (wght 300–800): interface text and tabular figures. SIL Open Font License 1.1, see OFL-inter.txt.
- Outfit (wght 200–700): display figures such as the main temperature. SIL Open Font License 1.1, see OFL-outfit.txt.
Registered in .streamlit/config.toml ([[theme.fontFaces]]); served from /app/static. No request to Google at runtime.
